title: Week 1
verification_note: Every line is DraftKings' own number, pulled through The Odds API.

tickets.name: Cardinals +9.5
tickets.why: Sharp money on Arizona (36% of tickets, 62% of handle). My number LAC -8.5. Week 1 dogs of 6.5+ are 32-13-1 ATS since 2013.
tickets.kill_switch: At +9 or lower, or if Jeremiyah Love is inactive, cut to $7.50 and move the rest to Under 41.5.

tickets.name: Under 41.5
tickets.why: Spread moved two points to Pittsburgh, total did not move. A third-string QB lowers both team totals. My number 39.5.

tickets.name: Vikings -1.5
tickets.why: Green Bay without Josh Jacobs, Micah Parsons, and two linemen who missed all preseason. Murray at home in a dome. My number MIN -3.

tickets.name: Dolphins +3
tickets.why: On the key number. My number LV -2. Brock Bowers out for Las Vegas, Miami has no designations.

tickets.name: Panthers +3
tickets.why: 93% of tickets on a road favorite in its first road game of a second-year system. My number CHI -1.5. Carolina's line is banged up, hence $5.
tickets.kill_switch: Pass if the price is worse than -110.
